metadata.description: Live POST /v1/decisions response: a predicate whose answer came back with name null (probe sent no question name; the adapter always sends names, so it never sees this). The response body is verbatim from the live probe; the request is reconstructed from the verified wire shape (issue #180). providerRequest omits `name` on purpose: that is how the probe was sent, and the API echoes `name: null` back. aimatey always sends `name`.
